Every one of the 14 body rows on p3 and p4 has an EMPTY Date / Name / Address / Purpose cell and a single BARE DASH in the Amount column; per the ZERO-GLYPH RULING a bare dash is a nil mark, not a numeral, so those rows are blank and NOT transcribed (there is no name or date to attach a value to in any case).
